artifacts.commit_message: Fix Bleeding Cool desktop content-site layout

manifest.name: scriptexts bleeding-cool desktop layout fix
manifest.description: Fixes Bleeding Cool desktop layout in the shared content-site-modernizer builder, scopes feed cards away from sidebars, removes white source wrappers, adds run-builder helper, and refreshes generated outputs.

commit.message: Fix Bleeding Cool desktop content-site layout

notes: This overlay is intended for the Scriptexts repo after the AIPT/content-site-modernizer patch.
Bleeding Cool desktop cards are scoped to the main content region so sidebar widgets no longer become card towers.
Source page wrappers are forced transparent by the generated userscript runtime/styles.
tools/run-builder.sh auto-discovers builders and uses fzf when available, otherwise an indexed prompt.

artifacts.commit_message: Reduce Bleeding Cool modernizer runtime cost

manifest.name: scriptexts bleeding-cool performance fix
manifest.description: Reduces Bleeding Cool content-site-modernizer runtime cost by disabling live DOM observation for that profile, limiting feed work, narrowing ad sweeps, and adding low-resource CSS.

commit.message: Reduce Bleeding Cool modernizer runtime cost

notes: Bleeding Cool now opts into lowResource mode, disables the MutationObserver, and limits initial feed enhancement to 42 primary stories.
The runtime now supports per-profile performance options without changing MenOfPorn or AIPT profile behavior unless they opt in.
Ad cleanup for Bleeding Cool uses narrower selectors to avoid repeated broad document scans.

artifacts.commit_message: Polish Bleeding Cool modern reader layout

manifest.name: scriptexts bleeding-cool layout and article cleanup
manifest.description: Fixes Bleeding Cool desktop layout weight and visual defects: normalized feed cards, better image fit, hidden native white wrappers, no empty card placeholders, and cleaned article pages/social blocks.

commit.message: Polish Bleeding Cool modern reader layout

notes: Bleeding Cool feed cards are normalized to a small, predictable DOM with one title, one optional meta row, and one media slot.
Bleeding Cool now requires a real story image for feed cards and de-duplicates by canonical href, preventing empty placeholder cards and repeated native modules.
Native white wrapper backgrounds, oversized social share blocks, related-post rows, ad rows, and sidebars are hidden or neutralized on article pages.
Card media uses contain fit for Bleeding Cool so thumbnails and comic art are less aggressively cropped.

artifacts.commit_message: Restore Bleeding Cool feed and polish article cleanup

manifest.name: scriptexts bleeding-cool restored feed and article cleanup
manifest.description: Restores the missing Bleeding Cool feed by replacing the hard cap with load-more batching, removes native white backgrounds, filters empty cards, and tightens article/social cleanup.

commit.message: Restore Bleeding Cool feed and polish article cleanup

notes: Bleeding Cool no longer hard-caps the feed at 24 stories; it discovers all primary story cards and reveals them in lightweight batches.
A Load more stories button keeps desktop pages responsive without making the rest of the feed disappear.
Image detection ignores placeholder/tracking images and cloned lazy images preserve real src/srcset data.
Bleeding Cool page wrappers are forced transparent/dark so the native white column is removed.
Article pages hide giant native social blocks, related modules, footer cruft, and share links more aggressively.
